description: Free post-payment step. Call only after the merchant x402 payment for a previously approved authorization. Verifies the Base USDC settlement on-chain and, when it matches the authorization, returns a signed settlement receipt. The authorization token comes from authorize_x402_ap2; payment_response is the merchant x402 PAYMENT-RESPONSE when available. No additional Trust fee is charged.

authorization_token.description: Signed authorization_token returned by authorize_x402_ap2 for the exact merchant request.

payment_response.description: Optional merchant x402 PAYMENT-RESPONSE header/value from the completed payment; omit only when on-chain reconciliation can identify the settlement.

name: verify_settlement
